Baltimore Gets 7-4 Win
Due in large part to third baseman DJ Layton, the Baltimore Orioles sunk the Detroit Tigers, 7-4. Layton went 3-4 with 3 singles and a walk. He scored 3 times. Parker Hutyra got the win, improving to 5-8. He pitched 5 innings, giving up 3 hits and 1 run, while striking out 5 and walking 3. Cody Laweryson notched his 29th save in 33 chances.

Who knows how it might've ended, had it not been for Thomas Sosa? The Baltimore right fielder had a 2-run double in the top of the fifth inning to put the Orioles on top, 5-1. For the game, Sosa had 1 double and 1 single in 4 at-bats.

"Our goal is to improve each and every day," Layton told the Baltimore Daily.

The Orioles improved their record to 63-43 by beating Detroit.
